recipes.purpose: Keep one short idea at a stable anchor while the previous idea compacts into context.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Reveal the main keyword from the fixed content anchor; add one supporting mark.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Hold the keyword and shift caption weight without duplicating narration on screen.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Compact the current keyword into one history mark before the next keyword claims the anchor.

qa: Main-stage text is not a full narration sentence.
Outgoing and incoming ideas never reach zero opacity in the same frame.

recipes.purpose: Show a local screenshot, article crop, or product evidence before handing focus to one conclusion.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Reveal the evidence in a bounded media surface and focus its relevant region.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Keep the evidence visible while a source label and one callout land.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Slide or unzoom the evidence into context and give visual weight to the conclusion.

qa: Asset path, hash, source, and license receipt are present.
Image motion is seek-safe and the evidence remains readable at the terminal state.

recipes.purpose: Explain an app, browser, terminal, or editor by moving through real interface states.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Stage the first real interface surface and establish its device or window context.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Move the content camera between at most three approved interface states.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Return to the overview or retain the last state as evidence for the next beat.

qa: No iframe or live network content is used.
The host and caption layers do not move with the content camera.

recipes.purpose: Build a genuine process, dependency, hierarchy, or causal relationship one node at a time.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Place the first node, then draw only connectors supported by the narration relationship.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Advance focus through the active nodes while completed nodes remain as context.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Pull back to the complete readable relationship and hold its conclusion.

qa: The relationship is encoded in Graph IR rather than inferred from visual decoration.
Use the 1920x1080 flowchart block, never flowchart-vertical in a 16:9 project.

recipes.purpose: Give a sourced numeric claim physical weight with one focused chart or fill.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Introduce one sourced metric and grow its proportional visual from a deterministic baseline.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Hold the terminal value with its unit and source label fully readable.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Dim supporting marks and carry only the conclusion into the next beat.

qa: Claim ledger contains an external source or explicitly marks the value as creator opinion.
One chart answers one narration claim; no dashboard grids or random numbers.

recipes.purpose: Keep exactly two states visible so the viewer can compare them without a page flip.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Bring the two states in from mirrored directions and keep equal spatial weight.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Shift focus between the states while both remain readable.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Morph the chosen state into the next beat anchor instead of clearing the frame.

qa: The contrast rule is explicit and source-linked.

recipes.purpose: Use a real code or terminal surface to explain changes, failures, logs, or maintenance work.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Reveal the real editor, terminal, diff, or log surface with its focal lines visible.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Highlight or scroll to the exact evidence while the surrounding context remains legible.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Collapse the evidence into one maintenance or failure conclusion.

qa: Code is real project evidence or clearly labeled illustrative content.
No code text smaller than the approved video readability threshold.

recipes.purpose: Use one reusable local object or Lottie motif to make an abstract idea tangible and recall it later.

phases.name: build
phases.action: Introduce one local object with a single declared semantic role.

phases.name: breathe
phases.action: Transform or traverse the object only as the narration changes its meaning.

phases.name: resolve
phases.action: Park the object as context so a later callback can reuse its visual identity.

qa: The asset is frozen locally with provenance and license.
Lottie playback is seeked by HyperFrames and never runs on wall-clock time.
